title: Frozen SWAP 4.3.1 Surface-Water Storage Geometry Source Inventory

reader_domain.ordering_check: zbotdr(i) must not be below zbotdr(i-1) for i>1

sttab_reference_semantics.knots_3_to_22: zbotdr(1+nrpri)*(i-2)/20 for i=3..22, preserving frozen operation order
sttab_reference_semantics.aggregate_storage: sum open-secondary-channel contributions at each knot
sttab_reference_semantics.interpolation: piecewise linear in the prepared knot table

forward_inverse_behavior.outside_domain: legacy swap_error; modern candidate must fail closed unless a separately qualified remediation changes a frozen seam
forward_inverse_behavior.interval_selection: inclusive endpoints; first matching adjacent knot pair in descending table
forward_inverse_behavior.inverse_validity_precondition: prepared storage knots remain strictly monotone for reader-valid geometry; exact interpolation arithmetic can nevertheless place an endpoint result a few ULP outside a stored endpoint bound

source_level_risks.observation: STTAB(22,1) is evaluated as zbotdr*(22-2)/20.0d0; finite-precision multiply-then-divide can differ from zbotdr by about one ULP in either direction.
source_level_risks.consequence: When knot 22 rounds above zbotdr, a WLS exactly equal to the reader-admitted deepest secondary bottom can be rejected by SWSTLEV because its lower domain bound is STTAB(22,1), not zbotdr. The same rounding can create a tiny positive STTAB(22,2).
source_level_risks.classification: frozen reference boundary seam, not configurable numerical tolerance
source_level_risks.readiness_disposition: explicitly characterize and hold exact-bottom production behavior for a separate candidate/remediation decision; do not silently snap, smooth or widen the domain in D1 readiness

source_level_risks.observation: SWSTLEV and WLEVST evaluate the linear interpolation expression even at exact table knots rather than returning the stored knot value directly; finite-precision subtraction, multiplication and addition at interpolation fraction 0 or 1 can return a value a few ULP different from the stored endpoint.
source_level_risks.consequence: A forward SWSTLEV evaluation at a mathematically exact knot can produce storage just outside the stored WLEVST domain, including just above STTAB(1,2), so immediate inverse evaluation can fail even though the source level itself is a table knot.
source_level_risks.classification: frozen reference interpolation boundary seam, not configurable numerical tolerance
source_level_risks.readiness_disposition: characterize exact frozen arithmetic and require explicit production-candidate disposition; do not silently clamp, snap or widen the inverse domain in D1 readiness

state_classification.SWST: authoritative conserved physical storage state only for SWSEC=2
state_classification.WLS: derived from SWST by WLEVST for SWSEC=2; prescribed forcing for SWSEC=1
state_classification.STTAB: prepared immutable parameter data shared by geometry identity; never dynamic state
state_classification.WLSTAR: automatic-management control memory; not member of the storage-state object; routed to F-PM08D5
state_classification.WLSBAK: numerical oscillation history; not physical state

reference_mode_consequence.reason: below the surface the exact channel-area relation is quadratic in water level whereas frozen SWSTLEV linearly interpolates precomputed knot storage
reference_mode_consequence.allowed_future_route: an exact analytic geometry option may be investigated only as separately named and qualified physical behavior, never as a numerical-policy optimization
